label: Okada Japanese Restaurant (hibachi, ramen, Japanese-Chinese) — large menu
note: The large-menu stress test: six portrait pages (p1–6 of the PDF; p7–8 are the sake/cocktail/wine/beer lists, excluded as not what a diner photographs to choose food), ~150 items with D-codes. Sean reported in August that big menus make the model invent dishes — this is the menu that measures it. Traps: Hibachi Entrées has three sub-sections whose items are bare proteins ('Chicken', 'Salmon', 'Scallop'); the Children's Menu repeats 'Chicken', 'Steak', 'Salmon', 'Shrimp' and all four yakisoba names from the adult menu — real duplicates in different sections that dedupe must not merge; the Ramen Extra Toppings grid and soft-drink flavour grid are not dishes; photo captions ('Ahi Poke', 'Steam Soft Buns', 'Tuna, Salmon & Red Snapper', 'Crabmeat & Spicy Salmon Tower') repeat dish names. D25–D36 continue Small Plates onto p2 with no heading repeated there, so a missing section on those is acceptable. Section names keep their Japanese as printed; the matcher compares Latin text only.
